svg.title: How low can the bits go
svg.desc: Bits per stored weight from FP64 down to zero-storage operators, separating GPU kernels from proved theoretical limits.

svg.text: Bits per stored off-diagonal weight on a log scale. Sub-4-bit tiers are theory with no GPU kernel yet.

svg.text: 1-bit sign vs. 1.58-bit ternary on a 3-node grounded patch (BitLimits.lean)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Target row is (1, t) at t = 1/5. Sign-only forces t to +1 or -1, while ternary can round t to 0.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Sign-only hits local κ > 9 and diverges like 2/t as t goes to 0. Ternary stays at κ <= 3 and approaches 1.
